title: Checkpoint: digital root
prompt:
The **digital root** of a non-negative number: if it has one digit, it is itself; otherwise it is the digital root of the sum of its digits. Implement `process(int n)` recursively (loop-free helper allowed for digit sum).

Examples: 9875 → 9+8+7+5=29 → 2+9=11 → 1+1=2, so `2`.

tests.name: digital root
tests.hint: Digit sum first (n % 10 + recurse n / 10), then recurse on the process itself until n < 10.
